RESEARCH_ROLE: Matched teacher-state set for the 2v2 sharing-family distillation arms (Share-Encoder, Fully Shared+z, and the Generalist once its objective is frozen). Every 2v2 distilled arm consumes this ONE frozen state set.

ALLOCATOR_locked.source: STANDARDIZED_2V2_SPLIT_DEFEND_K1_SPEC (same allocator as the Separated arm)

ACTING_DEPLOYMENT_locked.why: States are visited under the live CLOSEST_DEFENDS allocator so the distilled arms train on the same role-structured state distribution the Separated arm sees.

KL_TEACHERS_locked.note: Acting policies generate the state distribution; KL teachers are the two single-strategy entity-repair specialists queried on every stored observation (same procedure as 4v4).

DATASET.roles_provenance: CLOSEST_DEFENDS roles attached at the stored pre-action tick (Pole A composite requires them for acting; stored for allocator audit; KL teachers ignore roles)
DATASET.entities_required: entity-repair teachers fail closed without teammates/enemies tensors at distillation time

SEEDS.chosen_by: seed_registry next_free + allocate before this freeze; the collector refuses unless both are registered and RESERVED, and sets them SPENT when the manifest is written
SEEDS.student_init_and_shuffle: allocated by the distillation spec, not here

POLES.source: the sealed 2v2 certification through pole_attestation (the collector refuses if these overlays disagree with the certified poles)
POLES.size_normalized_gate: live min_alive_for_defender must equal 2 from core._bt_resolved_profile_tensors()

COLLECTOR.module: experiments/collect_suite_distillation_states.py --team-size 2 (the one collector for every suite scale; k derived from N)
COLLECTOR.records_in_manifest: git identity, spec sha256, run fingerprint, seed-registry blocks, pole identity, allocator, acting pins, KL teacher pins, per-shard counts
COLLECTOR.crash_recovery: --resume reuses shards whose embedded fingerprint matches exactly

SMOKE_before_collection: the same command with --smoke (disposable 999xxxxx seeds, _SMOKE paths) must complete first
SAME_RECIPE_AS_4V4: identical to the corrected 4v4 collection except N (2), k (1), seeds, checkpoint paths/hashes and tensor shapes that follow from N; enforced by the cross-scale dataset audit before any student is trained
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: reusing these seeds for any evaluation
collecting without CLOSEST_DEFENDS(k=1) on Pole A
